warnings: S1 and S2 each print TWO typical sections on this sheet — 'ด้านสั้น' (short side) and 'ด้านยาว' (long side) — describing the same slab type's two-way reinforcement. Both are folded into one element per mark (one entry per §0.1) with the short/long-side bar detail kept in the note field, rather than creating two entries with the same element_id.

'คอม้าเส้นเว้นเส้น' (alternating bent-up/straight bar pattern) is a Thai slab-reinforcement convention (alternate bars bent up near supports) — recorded verbatim in the note rather than translated into a structured field, since the schema has no dedicated slot for it.

S1's long-side total (4.00+3.00=7.00m) and short-side total (2.375+2.125=4.50m) both exactly match this house's main grid dimension chains (y: B-C+A-B; x: 1-1"+1"-2) — consistent with S1 being the typical floor-slab detail for the main 1-2 x A-D bays.
